messages:
emily: Quick idea — show a tiny "impact peek" when you change a per-route model preset in Console: tokens/call, est monthly delta, and telemetry drift highlights.

ryan: +1. Current flow surprises teams after rollout. small inline preview avoids that.

theo: We should include fallback behavior: list fallback model + delta. Otherwise cost math is wrong.

telemetry-bot: note: preview-service historically spikes for large routes; recommend heuristic fast-path then exact async.

emily: API sketch:
POST /api/route-impact/peek
{ route_id, preset, window_days }
-> { tokens_per_call, monthly_cost_delta, latency_p50_delta_ms, sample_pct_change, fallback_model }

ryan: UX: show compact pill near "Save" with "~980 t/c · +$120/mo · +8% sample" and an expandable details row with sparklines for latency/error.

theo: infra: cache by (route,preset,window) TTL 10m, rate-limit per-org. async fallback text "estimate updating" ok.

sara: perms: org_billing_admin see absolute dollar; others see relative badges. saved-query with pinned preset should show "affects N routes" modal before save.

emily: rollout: feature-flag preview_peek_v1, start with internal beta. I'll add figma mocks.

ryan: I'll add an API PR and tests for fallback path.

theo: I'll add caching + feature flag.

telemetry-bot: deploy note: preview-peek feature flag rollout scheduled 2024-07-15 04:00 UTC.

emily: great — will post mocks and follow-ups. Thanks!
